help_menu: 🧭 MusicFlow Help Choose a section below to view the commands available in this chat. Each command includes a short description, so you can find what you need without scrolling through a long list.
help_admins: 🎚️ Playback Controls /pause — Pause the current stream. /resume — Resume playback. /skip — Move to the next track. /stop — End the current session. /seek [seconds] — Move forward in the current track. /seekback [seconds] — Move backward in the current track. /reload — Refresh the administrator cache.
help_auth: 🪪 Authorized Users /auth — Allow a user to control playback without being a chat administrator. /unauth — Revoke a previously granted authorization.
help_blist: 🚫 Blacklist /blacklist [chat_id|user_id] — Restrict a chat or user from using the bot. /unblacklist [chat_id|user_id] — Lift the restriction.
help_lang: 🗺️ Language /lang — Change the language MusicFlow uses in this chat.
help_ping: 🛰️ General Commands /help — Open this help menu. /ping — Check bot response time and system status. /start — Open the MusicFlow welcome screen. /sudolist — View the configured sudo users, where permitted.
help_play: 🎼 Music Commands /play [song, artist or URL] — Search for a track and play it in the active voice chat. /vplay [song, artist or URL] — Play the video version, where available. Example /play Blinding Lights
help_queue: 🗂️ Queue /queue — View the current track and what's coming up next. /playing — Open the current playback details.
help_sudo: 🔐 Owner & Sudo Commands These commands are restricted to the owner or authorized sudo users, and are intentionally hidden from the regular Help menu.
